items.docs:
Returns a list of Scoops from ZoomInfo's data which meet the specified search criteria.

- Input parameters may require specific values, some of which are too extensive to list in the parameter descriptions. You can retrieve these values using the [Lookup](#28358f09-9863-42af-a93c-6710a8cacf9d) endpoints.
- If you do not provide a date range for when the scoop was published, the last 30 days of scoop records matching the request are returned
    

**Input params**

| Parameter | DataType | Descr
Returns a list of fields you can use as input for the [Scoop Search](#3099d72f-6857-4432-89c2-736410680e60) endpoint.
Returns a list of fields included in the response for the [Scoop Search](#3099d72f-6857-4432-89c2-736410680e60) endpoint.
